car.source: UK DEFRA 2023 GHG Conversion Factors — Average Petrol/Diesel Car (Medium)
car.assumption: Average UK medium petrol/diesel car; per-vehicle-km, shared across all passengers in the vehicle rather than multiplied per passenger.

train.source: UK DEFRA 2023 GHG Conversion Factors — National Rail (average)
train.assumption: UK national rail average across the current electrification/diesel traction mix.

bus.source: UK DEFRA 2023 GHG Conversion Factors — Local Bus (not London), average occupancy
bus.assumption: Average local bus occupancy outside London; excludes coach/express services.

flight.source: ICAO Carbon Emissions Calculator Methodology (2023), with DEFRA 1.9x radiative forcing index
flight.assumption: Short/medium-haul economy class average, including non-CO2 high-altitude warming effects.

hotel-night.source: Cornell Hotel Sustainability Benchmarking Index 2023 (global blended average)
hotel-night.assumption: Blended global average across hotel star ratings and climate zones; per occupied room-night.

default.assumption: No single authoritative per-hour activity emissions dataset exists; estimated from typical venue/tour energy intensity (heating, cooling, lighting, transport within activity) prorated per visitor-hour.

outdoor.assumption: Outdoor, low-infrastructure activities (hiking, walking tours, beaches); mainly incidental transport/amenity energy, no climate control.

indoor_venue.source: EcoRoute internal estimate, calibrated against CIBSE Guide F venue energy-intensity benchmarks
indoor_venue.assumption: Indoor venues with HVAC and lighting load (museums, galleries, indoor attractions), prorated per visitor-hour.
